name: Guacamole
desc: Chunky guacamole with lime, red onion, cilantro, and tomato.

source.title: How to Make the Best Guacamole
source.evidence: Same 2 avocados, 2 tbsp onion, 2 tbsp cilantro and 1/2 tomato; supplies salt, lime juice and the onion type (red). The page's serrano is left out, as the site recipe never had it.

ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp fine salt, plus more to taste
2 tbsp finely chopped fresh cilantro (leaves and tender stems)

steps: Halve the avocados, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash roughly with a fork, leaving it a little chunky.
Sprinkle with the salt and lime juice, then stir in the onion, cilantro, pepper, and tomato.
Taste and add more salt or lime if needed. Serve right away with tortilla chips.
tips: Simply Recipes adds 1 to 2 minced serrano or jalapeño chiles if you want heat.

references.title: How to Make the Best Guacamole
references.usedFor: amounts, red onion, fork-mash method, serrano option
